snippet.title: Trailer Yatzy
snippet.description:
Yatzy is the popular dice game played in a variety of ways all over the world. The object of Yatzy is to score the most points by rolling five dice to compile various required dice combinations. Your score is easily recorded by clicking on the appropriate cell on the scorecard corresponding to the selected dice combination. You can play Yatzy with up to six players, or you can play against as many as five computer opponents.

Available for desktop and mobile. Try it for free at:
http://www.bakno.com/Yatzy
